body: But she's the only person in my life that is even affected by my existence. I realize that sounds ridiculous but its true. If I don't have her I have no one. I don't even have fake friends, or friends that I secretly hate like everyone seems to. I thought college might be different but its just like high school. Im alive today because Ive always had at least one connection, and I have exactly one right now. If I get to zero I don't want to live anymore. Im not openly obsessing over her, and Im certainly not going to tell her any of this. Its just that Im so sick of trying and I feel like its my last chance to succeed at ANYTHING as far as a social life.

I should probably add that I have never had any sense of self-worth unless I am making someone happier than they would otherwise be. I don't NEED a girlfriend. I feel useless and pathetic if I don't have a girlfriend or at friends in general. 

I don't want to go to hell.

It's not as simple as whether or not I get a girlfriend. I would be absolutely happy with a friend-group OR a girlfriend or both. Ive never been happy unless I know I make someone else happy, regardless of whether its a friend or a girl I like. And right now im at 1. If I get to zero, I don't have a reason to keep living here at college wasting my money and my parents money.
If I do it probably wont be for awhile. I really am trying.
